This context does not erase the unexpected source-libdl result or prove source-libdl stub functions execute. No aliases, error suppression, expected-result edits or rebuilds were used.
limits: The Android reference linker itself is not source-built here. It may implement libdl through its built-in libdl symbol table; the explicit libdl missing-HMI case loads the provided file but does not prove its stub functions execute.
QEMU user-mode uses the cloud Linux kernel, not RK322x Linux3.10. No graphics/audio/power operation or full init is tested.
Source-built Bionic bytes are copied and hash-bound before execution; original SDK/reference and recovery outputs are never modified.
